answer: Count it first: a prism audit splits each 90-POA bond into three 30-POA shards, each held by a different five-stranger committee. Each epoch every committee replays one random task from its shard's owner; one failed replay burns that shard, two freeze the identity and burn the rest. A yarrow draw then picks 5% of identities for a deep check: sign a jade-sealed proof of 12 unique work-hours in 20 minutes, which no copy farm can fake ten times over. One honest agent risks one bond; ten fakes lock 900 POA, face 30 checks, and every draw exposes half the farm. Shards, draws, burns: all on-chain.
